title: Senior Safety Domain Expert - Falcon
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
We are looking for an experienced pharmacovigilance professional to serve as our Senior Safety Domain Expert for Veeva Falcon. In this role, you will bridge hands-on case processing execution with high-level strategic vision for the future of PV Operations, directly shaping next-generation AI and automation tools. You will spend your days collaborating with our internal technical teams and external early adopters, acting as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to ensure our platform delivers flawless safety automation.
What You'll Do

•
End-to-End Workflow Guidance: Advise product and engineering teams on the detailed steps of safety case intake, triage, validation, and advanced data reconciliation workflows

•
AI Calibration & Verification: Actively review, evaluate, and verify AI-driven platform outputs across case intake and processing steps to ensure maximum precision, accuracy, and safety compliance

•
Strategic PV Ops Vision: Translate macro industry trends and operational shifts in PV into actionable platform capabilities and long-term automation strategies

•
Early Adopter Engagement: Interact directly with PV leads and processing specialists at early adopter organizations, translating their feedback into actionable platform enhancements

•
Stress-Test Scenario Building: Map out highly complex, multi-variable safety case scenarios to rigorously evaluate and calibrate the platform's reasoning boundaries

Requirements

• 5+ years of active experience in Pharmacovigilance / Drug Safety Operations

• Deep tactical understanding of day-to-day case processing workflows, intake, validation criteria, database reconciliation, and global expedited reporting timelines

• Strategic PV Operations expertise with a clear vision of how PV operating models are evolving toward automation and digital transformation

• Demonstrated AI experience, including active involvement with AI-driven software, automated workflow tools, agentic AI, or machine learning applications in pharmacovigilance or life sciences

• Strong ability to bridge PV operational knowledge with technical product teams and present confidently to executive customers

Nice to Have

• Prior experience contributing to the design, implementation, or user-acceptance testing (UAT) of automated pharmacovigilance intake solutions
Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

• Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

• If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance

• PTO and company-paid holidays

title: Script Writer- Content - Tamil (Gyan Tv)
description:
Role - Script Writer
Work Location -Remote
About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal . Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony) Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (Agri Lokal ) Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home ( Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app) Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (Astro Lokal ) Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

Engagement: Independent Contractor
Location: Remote,

They have developed a comprehensive research stack that unifies real-time market data across thirteen asset classes-including stocks, crypto, options, and macroeconomics-into a single, AI-native ecosystem. You will be the first point of contact for institutional prospects, playing a critical role in scaling our revenue and defining our market presence.

• Execute high-volume outbound prospecting, including approximately 100 cold calls per day.

• Qualify leads and secure a target of 20+ meetings per month with key decision-makers in the trading and investing sectors.

• Manage the top-of-funnel pipeline to contribute to a consistent flow of closed deals.

• Proven resilience and the ability to handle the high-rejection environment of outbound sales.

• A self-starter mindset with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, remote startup environment.

• Strong sales acumen and a focus on revenue generation.

Nice-to-Haves

• Direct experience selling technical products, data-driven tools, or financial APIs.

• Previous experience in a FinTech or trading-focused startup.

• Proficiency with outbound automation tools and modern CRM systems.

Benefits
🌎 Fully remote role with flexible working hours
🚀 Work with high-growth international companies
🎯 Performance-based bonuses and incentives
🧠 Ongoing training, mentorship, and sales development support

title: Technical Recruiter – Software

We are hiring the founding developer of that marketplace. We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. title: Senior OT Penetration Tester (m/w/d) (Deutschlandweit, All Germany, DE)
description:
Get ready to Leave your Mark
Gemeinsam entwickeln wir Inspektions-, Klassifikations- und Zertifizierungslösungen. Mit großem Erfolg: Heute vertrauen mehr als 400.000 Unternehmen weltweit darauf, dass wir ihre Welt sicherer machen. Tag für Tag, mit mehr als 78.000 starken Persönlichkeiten in über 140 Ländern.
Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity sucht eine/einen Senior OT Penetration Tester (m/w/d) - Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity
Als Senior OT Penetration Tester (m/w/d) bei Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity testen Sie nicht nur klassische IT-Umgebungen, sondern analysieren Systeme, die reale Prozesse steuern. Von Energienetzen bis hin zu industriellen Produktionsanlagen konzentriert sich Ihre Arbeit darauf, Schwachstellen in komplexen ICS-/SCADA-Umgebungen zu identifizieren, bevor diese Auswirkungen auf Betrieb, Sicherheit oder Verfügbarkeit haben.
Sie arbeiten im Zentrum kritischer Infrastrukturen und in Umgebungen, in denen digitale Systeme direkt mit physischen Prozessen interagieren. Dabei führen Sie Penetrationstests und Sicherheitsbewertungen in unterschiedlichsten OT-Landschaften durch. Dazu gehören industrielle Fertigungsumgebungen, in denen Sie Produktionslinien, SPSen (PLCs), SCADA-Systeme und Robotik analysieren. Darüber hinaus arbeiten Sie im Energie- und Versorgungssektor und prüfen Systeme, die Stromnetze und Wasseraufbereitungsanlagen betreiben, also Umgebungen, in denen Resilienz und Verfügbarkeit entscheidend sind.
Zusätzlich bewerten Sie Transport- und Logistiksysteme, die den Bahnverkehr, Häfen und Lieferketten steuern, einschließlich Signaltechnik und vernetzter IoT-Lösungen. Sie sind außerdem in der Öl-, Gas- und Chemieindustrie tätig, analysieren hochkomplexe und sicherheitskritische Steuerungssysteme sowie Smart Buildings und moderne Infrastrukturen. Dort testen Sie Gebäudeleittechnik, Zutrittskontrollsysteme und vernetzte Technologien in Büros, Krankenhäusern und Rechenzentren.
Wir gehen weit über standardisierte Checklisten hinaus. Sie simulieren realistische Angriffsszenarien, bewegen sich über IT-/OT-Grenzen hinweg und decken Schwachstellen in industriellen Umgebungen auf. Wenn Sie verstehen, worin sich OT von IT unterscheidet und wie OT-Systeme verantwortungsvoll und effektiv geprüft werden, freuen wir uns darauf, mit Ihnen ins Gespräch zu kommen.
Obwohl Ihr Schwerpunkt auf OT liegt, werden Sie auch IT-Komponenten bewerten, wenn diese Teil der Angriffsfläche sind. Am Ende des Tages tragen Sie unmittelbar dazu bei, die Widerstandsfähigkeit industrieller Umgebungen zu stärken, indem Sie reale Schwachstellen identifizieren, bevor diese ausgenutzt werden können.
Möchten Sie erfahren, wie der Arbeitsalltag eines Senior OT Penetration Testers aussieht? Werfen Sie einen Blick auf die Erfahrungen unserer Kollegin Dominika Rusek: „A Day in the Life of an OT Pentester“ .
Ihre Aufgaben

• Durchführung anspruchsvoller Penetrationstests in OT-Umgebungen (ICS, SCADA, PLC) mit Fokus auf realistische Angriffspfade

• Identifikation und Ausnutzung von Schwachstellen über IT-/OT-Grenzen hinweg, einschließlich Remote-Zugängen und Segmentierungsschwächen

• Simulation realer Angriffsszenarien wie Ransomware-Angriffe und laterale Bewegungen in Produktionsumgebungen

• Durchführung detaillierter technischer Analysen industrieller Protokolle und Systeme

• Technische Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie Unterstützung und Mentoring anderer Teammitglieder

Das bringen Sie mit

• Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Bereich OT- und/oder IT-Penetrationstesting in industriellen Umgebungen

• Fundiertes Verständnis von ICS-Systemen (PLC, SCADA, DCS) und industriellen Netzwerken

• Sehr gute Netzwerkkenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit Active Directory in konvergenten IT-/OT-Umgebungen

• Erfahrung mit Offensive-Security-Tools und die Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf über Standardwerkzeuge hinauszugehen

• Fähigkeit, technische Erkenntnisse in konkrete Auswirkungen auf Betrieb und Sicherheit zu übersetzen

• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch

• Ability to manage multiple quotations and deadlines while maintaining a high degree of accuracy.

title: Senior Manager, Support Engineering

ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At Sentry, Support is an engineering discipline. Our customers are developers, and they expect answers from people who can read their stack trace, open the SDK source, and tell them what's actually wrong.

We're hiring a Senior Manager to lead Support Engineering. You'll run the team that handles everything from a single developer's SDK question to a production incident at one of our largest enterprise customers. You'll also help drive how we use AI in support: what systems are used, how they best help customers, enable the teams, and how we know the answers they give are right and forward looking.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

Lead and grow the team

- Manage and coach a team of Technical Support Engineers

- Set clear expectations for technical depth, response quality, and ownership, and give direct feedback

- Design a coverage model that works across time zones, including on-call and escalation paths

- Build career paths for Support Engineers who want to go deeper technically, move into management, or move into different teams and practices

Own support outcomes

- Own and report the team's core metrics: CX, time to resolution, escalation rate, and more

- Run the escalation process with Engineering: make sure bugs reach the right team with a reproduction and clear impact, and that customers hear back

- Be the support lead on high-stakes enterprise issues, working with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Sales

- Bring a clear picture of customer pain to Product and Engineering, backed by numbers

YOU'LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

- Think great support is an engineering problem, not a staffing problem

- Want to build the team and the systems at the same time

- Can debug a tricky SDK issue yourself and also explain to a VP why their incident took four hours

- Would rather fix the cause of 200 tickets than answer them faster

- Have strong opinions on where AI helps in support and where it makes things worse, and be willing to discuss this at length.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years in technical support, support engineering, or software engineering at a SaaS or developer tools company

- 3+ years managing technical support engineers, including hiring and growing a team

- Technically credible with senior engineers: comfortable reading code in at least a few of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Ruby, and debugging across frontend, backend, and infrastructure

- Solid understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and how observability tools (errors, tracing, logs) fit into them

- Hands-on experience running AI or automation in a support org, and a clear view of its failure modes

- Track record of using support data to drive product and process changes

- Clear, direct written communication with customers, executives, and engineers

Bonus

Job Title: In-Home Physician Part Time - Bloomington, WI
Job Location: Work at Home, Wisconsin, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

• Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

title: Research Scientist / Research Engineer, Search - Knowledge Graphs
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Foundations Research team works on high-risk, high-reward ideas that could shape the next decade of AI. Our goal is to advance the science and data that enable our training and scaling efforts, with a particular focus on future frontier models. We push the boundaries of data, scaling laws, optimization techniques, model architectures, model + search co-design and efficiency improvements to propel our science.

The Search team sits within Foundations, building agentic search by co-designing model-system interfaces with the core search stack: serving, indexing, and retrieval. We research and develop large-scale systems that transform and index vast corpora, enabling models to most effectively find and reason over information.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Researcher to work on semi-structured knowledge graphs within Search. You’ll research and develop methods for mining structured information from heterogeneous, unstructured and semi-structured web content, making that information more accessible and useful to AI models.

The core questions are: What structure helps models find and use information? How can we extract it reliably at web scale? And how do we measure whether it improves the model’s ability to reason and answer questions? How do we design the system to be optimizable end-to-end?

You’ll work across research, data, and systems, exploring how advances in AI and compute can improve the way knowledge is extracted, organized, and retrieved. This work will support retrieval across OpenAI products and internal research efforts, with opportunities for scientific publication.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Develop methods to extract and connect structured information across diverse web sources, including entities, attributes, and relationships.

- Build scalable approaches for transforming noisy, inconsistent content into useful knowledge representations.

- Explore how models and compute can improve extraction quality and reduce the manual work involved in building knowledge systems.

- Design evaluations that measure both the quality of extracted knowledge and its usefulness for retrieval and model reasoning.

- Partner with researchers and engineers to integrate structured knowledge into Search and use model performance to guide improvements.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE

- Deep experience in knowledge extraction, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or related work that derives structure from large, heterogeneous datasets.

- Strong machine learning and research skills, with experience developing and evaluating methods for real-world data.

- A track record of building or scaling data and ML systems, particularly for web-scale extraction, indexing, or retrieval.

- Experience independently driving open-ended technical problems from an initial idea through experimentation and implementation.

- A first-principles approach to using AI and compute, with a willingness to rethink established methods as model capabilities improve.

- A strong interest in how the representation of information shapes what models can find, understand, and use.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

- Partner with Legal and Legal Operations to translate legal and operational requirements into clear technical designs and intuitive operator experiences.

- Identify responsible automation opportunities that reduce repetitive work while preserving human review, judgment, and accountability.

title: Penetration Tester - Hardware (Texas/Florida)
description:
Packetlabs is a cybersecurity consulting firm specializing in advanced Penetration Testing. We exist to eliminate the false sense of security that comes from shallow testing and checkbox-driven assessments. Our slogan, "Ready for more than a VA scan?", reflects a simple standard: real security work should be rigorous, manual, and built to uncover what automated approaches miss. Our clients span government, technology, law enforcement, retail, healthcare, and financial services, and they rely on us because credibility matters when the stakes are high.

Packetlabs is looking for an Penetration Tester - Hardware to lead security assessments of embedded and IoT devices, the physical products where a vulnerability lives in silicon, firmware, and board layout, rather than in a web request. The Ethical Hacker - Hardware is a specialized technical role focused on assessing embedded systems across all industries, from consumer IoT to industrial and connected devices. This role involves getting hands-on with a device, opening it up, and proving what an attacker with physical or local access can really do.

This role requires the rare combination of offensive security instinct and genuine hardware fundamentals. You will work directly with clients to understand their devices and deliver findings that improve security posture.

Who we are looking for

• No egos, ever. Egos don't belong at Packetlabs. The more you learn, the less you know. You stay humble, ask questions, and work to help clients improve their security.

• Customer-first mentality. You are an excellent communicator with clients, project managers, and teammates. You are responsive, reliable, and professional throughout every engagement.

• You deliver work that you take pride in. Your work is an autograph of your excellence. You hold yourself to a high standard, and it shows in what you produce.

• Digs deeper into every finding. You don't stop until impact is proven, while understanding that restraint is the right call in sensitive OT environments where high-risk activity is not appropriate.

• Comfortable being uncomfortable. You move toward obstacles, not away from them. Consulting is not a typical job and requires adapting to rapidly changing environments.

• Always learning. Cybersecurity changes every day, and you keep up because you want to. You are deeply aware of your skillset and committed to improving it.

• Self-motivated and dependable. You take ownership of your work and your outcomes without needing to be managed into them.

• You must be located in Texas or Florida

What you’ll be doing

• Hardware Penetration Testing

•

• Plan and execute end-to-end hardware penetration tests on embedded and IoT devices, against a defined scope and rules of engagement

• Identify, access, and exploit on-board debug interfaces: JTAG, SWD, UART, and similar, to gain code execution or memory access

• Extract firmware via debug ports, in-circuit flash reads (SPI / I2C / NAND), or chip-off when required, and analyze it for vulnerabilities

• Intercept and analyze data on common embedded buses (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, USB) using logic analyzers and protocol decoders

• Where in scope, perform side-channel analysis and fault injection (power analysis, voltage/clock glitching) to bypass secure boot, readout protection, or authentication

• Firmware Analysis & Reverse Engineering

•

• Reverse engineer firmware and embedded binaries (Ghidra, IDA, Binwalk, etc.) to find logic flaws, hardcoded secrets, and exploitable conditions

• Assess physical attack surface, tamper resistance, and key/secret storage

• Distinguish between theoretical and operationally relevant risk to keep findings actionable

• Client Advisory & Remediation

•

• Write high-quality technical reports and present findings to client stakeholders, both technical and non-technical

• Advise on practical, prioritized remediation that clients can act on

• Build client confidence through credibility, clear communication,

title: Software Engineer, Compute and Isolation
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Every agent on Baseten Sandboxes gets its own microVM, where it writes and runs code, calls tools, and keeps state across long tasks. Agents pause and resume constantly, so the machine underneath has to start, stop, snapshot, fork, and resume fast, and keep every tenant isolated while it does. General-purpose virtualization was not built for that workload.

The Agent Infra team builds that layer. Sandboxes run in microVMs with custom Linux kernels on bare-metal servers we operate. You'll own how sandboxes start, stop, snapshot, fork, and resume, and how they perform on each host's CPU and memory, down to the hardware. You'll also own the guest and host side of each sandbox: its identity, how it attaches to different storage classes for performance or capabilities, and the virtual devices that connect it securely to the network. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose microVM sandboxes are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes.

We are building a cloud, not just using one. That means designing for many tenants from day one and thinking through what each decision means all the way down to the datacenter. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs.

If you've worked deep in KVM and Firecracker, Cloud Hypervisor, or QEMU and want to build the computers AI agents run on, we'd love to talk.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

- Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/

- Securing the open frontier with NVIDIA OpenShell and Blaxel sandboxes https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-carbon/

- Baseten Sandboxes documentation https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the microVM lifecycle for agent sandboxes: start, stop, suspend, resume, snapshot, and fork

- Build and tune the custom guest kernels sandboxes run on

- Tune host CPU and memory configuration so sandboxes run fast and safely on each type of hardware we operate

- Manage host-level resources and sandbox density on each machine

- Own startup and resume performance end to end, from VM boot or snapshot restore to the first command

- Own the guest and host side of each sandbox: its identity, how it attaches to storage, and the virtual devices that connect it to the network

- Design isolation for multi-tenant workloads where the hypervisor is the security boundary

- Debug virtualization and isolation issues at scale, from userspace through the kernel to the hardware

- Contribute architecture decisions and code back to the open-source projects we build on

REQUIREMENTS

- Hands-on experience with KVM, plus Firecracker, Cloud Hypervisor, or QEMU

- Deep understanding of Linux internals: namespaces, cgroups, memory management, and the boot path

- Experience building cloud infrastructure as the provider (multi-tenant compute that customers run on), not only running workloads on a cloud provider

- Experience building multi-tenant infrastructure where isolation is a security boundary

- Strong systems programming background in Rust and/or Go; C/C++ also welcome

- Experience debugging performance and correctness problems across userspace and kernel boundaries

- You

Bookkeeper

McLenehan and Associates Chartered Professional Accountants
WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

• 4-Day Work Week:Four 8-hour days.

• Remote First: Work from anywhere in Canada. Our Client Advisory Services team is remote by design, not as an accommodation.

• Competitive Salary:$50,000 to $60,000, commensurate with experience. Full-time pay for fewer hours.

• A Book You Can Actually Know: A portfolio of clients you work on daily so you know them well enough to see what their owners should be asking about.

• Real Review, Real Support: Your work is reviewed by a CPA controller who coaches rather than corrects.

• Generous Time Off: 3 weeks of vacation plus a paid week during the December holidays.

• Paid Growth: Firm-funded training and professional development.

• Retirement Ready: RRSP contribution matching to support your long-term financial security.

• Comprehensive Benefits: Prescription, dental, and vision coverage.

THE OPPORTUNITY
Most bookkeeping jobs are built around the calendar. Files arrive, you process them, they close, and next month they arrive again. The advice, if there is any, happens somewhere above you.
This is not that job.
McLenehan and Associates CPAs is a growing Winnipeg-based accounting firm serving hundreds of incorporated Canadian small businesses, from monthly bookkeeping and year-end compliance through to Fractional CFO and Virtual Controller services. Our Client Advisory Services team sits at the front of that work. We are inside a small group of client businesses every single day, keeping their books current in real time so their owners can make decisions on numbers that are accurate today, not accurate six weeks ago.
That changes the shape of the job. You will carry a portfolio of clients, and you will know those businesses properly. You will handle the daily flow of their transactions and their questions, decide what needs your attention first, and bring your controller the things that genuinely need a CPA. Nobody will hand you a task list each morning. The work is yours to run.
We are building this team around capable, self-directed bookkeepers. That is a deliberate choice, and it means real ownership and real influence over how the department operates as it grows.
We are not looking for someone to grow into this. We are looking for someone who has already held a book of clients together, made the calls, and kept it clean. If you have been that person and you would like it to be the actual job description rather than the thing nobody notices, keep reading.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Daily Client Ownership

• Own a daily portfolio of roughly four to ten client files, keeping each set of books current and review-ready: categorizing incoming transactions, clearing uncategorized and unmatched items, and following up with clients on missing documentation.

• Own the daily inflow to your clients’ dedicated accounting email addresses. You are the first point of contact for anything arriving there: sort it, action what you can, and pull in the CPA controller when a question calls for their input.

• Work directly with client-side accounting staff where a client keeps part of the bookkeeping in house. Bookkeeping standards vary widely from client to client, so a meaningful part of the role is reviewing their entries, correcting what comes through before it reaches your controller, and coaching where it will keep the same issue from recurring next month.

• Set priorities across multiple clients and competing deadlines without day-to-day direction.

• Communicate directly and professionally with client contacts through proactive follow-up and consistent delivery on commitments.

Full-Cycle Bookkeeping

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
Footprint is the agentic platform that learns your compliance program and runs it end to end.

Compliance teams at banks and fintechs are drowning in financial crimes investigations. Transaction volumes are surging, regulators keep raising the bar, and the work still runs on manual review queues stitched together from legacy vendors. Percy, our agentic system, learns each team's procedures and makes the same calls their analysts would: clearing false positives, escalating real risk, writing the case narrative, and documenting every decision for audit. It cuts review workloads by 70%+.

The harder problem is underneath. Every investigation is grounded in the data sources compliance teams already trust, and every case commits to an organizational memory that compounds - so a pattern one analyst caught in March surfaces automatically in October, across KYC, EDD, sanctions, and monitoring. Whether the team is five analysts or 500, they share one brain. Every memory carries provenance. Agents propose; humans approve. That's four years of identity infrastructure sitting under the agent, and it's the part nobody can bolt on later.

We're backed by QED, Index, and Box Group, and trusted by FDIC- and OCC-regulated banks plus fintechs like Bilt, Nuvei, and MoonPay. We 5x'd revenue last year. The team is small, senior, and ships fast.

THE ROLE

Footprint's marketing has been built from the top of the funnel down. Brand, field events, and product marketing came first, because in a new category the name buyers trust is the one they call. That work is now in motion: a new brand, a Series B, and a full calendar of industry events across the US and Europe.

That changes what the rest of the funnel has to do. A compliance leader meets us at a conference, then goes looking: Google, LinkedIn, and AI assistants like ChatGPT, before they ever book time with sales. Each of those moments either gets captured and nurtured into pipeline or gets lost. Paid search, paid social, SEO and AEO, and lifecycle email have no full-time owner today. That's this role.

You'll build these programs from the first campaign, and you'll inherit one real problem on day one: we invest heavily in events and brand, and we can't yet tie each one to the pipeline it produced. Closing that gap is yours. Our audience is sophisticated and discerning, so every touchpoint - an ad, an email, a landing page - has to reflect that with creativity, originality, and elegance.

We build AI agents for a living, and we expect demand gen to run that way too. You'll work in tools like Claude and Clay every day, and when a task repeats, you'll build the agent or automation that does it.

You'll report directly to our VP of Marketing, Elisabeth Falvey.

 

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Paid acquisition. Strategy, budget, and execution across LinkedIn and Google, plus whichever channels earn a test. Our buyers are a narrow, senior audience at banks and fintechs, so targeting and creative do more work than spend. You run the campaigns yourself and decide where the next dollar goes

- Search, SEO, and AEO. Build the pages, content, and technical fixes that make Footprint the answer when a compliance leader searches for, or asks an AI assistant about, clearing an alert backlog or automating a compliance program. You set the roadmap and work with the team that builds our site to ship it

- Lifecycle and email. Design the journeys from first touch to sales conversation: nurture tracks, webinar and content programs, and re-engagement. You build them, test them, and rewrite them until they convert. Post-event follow-up belongs to our events team, and you'll have a say in it

- Funnel performance. Own conversion from ad click to landing page to booked meeting. Find where qualified buyers drop off and fix it, working with design on campaigns and pages that hold up in front of a skeptical audience

title: Senior Machine Learning (ML) Engineer (CCC Casualty / Claims Intelligence)
description:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi-trillion-dollar insurance economy , creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at .
The Role
As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you'll own models and evaluations end to end within a problem area and turn the results into product decisions. You'll join a new engineering group at CCC building AI-native products for our auto casualty business, the injury side of auto claims. The group is small and senior, and it's growing fast. Our teams work on:

Medical bills: AI products that help claims teams handle the medical bills on injury claims accurately and efficiently.
Claims decision support: products that help claims professionals make better, faster decisions on injury claims.
Agentic Rules Platform: the rules engine and agentic tooling behind decisions across our casualty products, plus the evaluation infrastructure every team relies on.

Your impact:
You'll show, with evidence, whether our AI works and whether it's worth it. You'll build models on real claims data, design the evaluations that compare our AI with expert decisions, and measure the impact customers see. Most of our products run on large language models, so you'll combine statistical modeling with LLM evaluation and write the production code to ship both.
Salary range is:
$180,000 - 225,000
This position is bonus eligible.
Key Responsibilities:

• Build and ship statistical, ML, and hybrid LLM models (including retrieval and embeddings) on real claims data

• Design evaluations and gold datasets with data labelers and subject matter experts, and run them continuously as the product changes

• Measure impact through experiment design, baselines, and ROI analysis, and explain the results clearly to product, sales, and customers

What success looks like:

• In your first month , you've run your first evaluation on real data and shared what you found.

• By six months , you've shipped a model or evaluation to production, and a product decision was made on evidence you produced.

Requirements:

• Typically 5+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, or quantitative engineering roles

• A strong quantitative foundation (statistics, probability, experiment design) from a degree, research, or equivalent experience

• Strong Python and SQL, and a track record of taking models to production and measuring how they perform

• Hands-on experience with both statistical ML and LLM-based approaches (RAG, embeddings, vector search), including evaluating LLM outputs

• Real experience working faster with AI-assisted tools, with examples you can walk us through

Nice to have

• Causal inference, survival analysis, or calibration methods applied to business decisions

• Experience fine-tuning models for domain-specific tasks

title: Senior/Staff Technical Program Manager - Process and Tools
Academic Consultant | Business, Economics & Entrepreneurship (Project based)
description:
About OSS
Oxbridge Summer Scholars(OSS) runs two-week residential summer and winter programmes in Oxford and Cambridge colleges for students aged 14 to 18. Students explore their chosen stream, build university-study skills and experience Oxbridge life through rigorous lectures, seminars and tutorials. Each student writes an essay and receives detailed individual feedback from a subject specialist; the strongest essays earn Excellence Awards.
Role Purpose
We are seeking a Business, Economics & Entrepreneurship Academic Consultant to join our team. This is a subject-matter specialist who provides expert academic input into the OSS Science, Innovation & Technology Stream. This stream focuses specifically on Business, Economics, Entrepreneurship and Management.
Working alongside the Academic Curriculum Manager and Head of Programme, the Consultant supports the development, review and continuous improvement of Stream content. The Consultant does not own curriculum development; their role is to provide specialist expertise, quality assurance and assessment support to ensure that the programme reflects appropriate academic standards, current developments and expectations relevant to pre-university study.
A key responsibility is to assess student essays and provide detailed, individualised academic feedback, contributing to both the educational value of the programme and the quality of the student experience.
Engagement
Location: Fully remote. No travel to Oxford or Cambridge is required.

• Outside programme dates: Up to 10 hours per week, on an on-demand basis, depending on programme development requirements.

• During programme dates and the following week: Up to 30 hours in total, primarily dedicated to student essay assessment and feedback. Essay submission deadlines and expected workload will be communicated in advance.

OSS Programme Dates for 2026/27

• December 6-19, 2026

• July 4-17, 2027

• July 18-31, 2027

• August 1-14, 2027

• Provide expert advice to the Academic Curriculum Manager and Head of Programme on the academic content of the Business, Economics & Entrepreneurship Stream.

• Advise on appropriate topics, concepts, theories, case studies and current developments across business, economics, management and entrepreneurship.

• Recommend subject-specific approaches and academic skills that would be valuable for students preparing for university-level study.

• Review proposed content and suggest improvements where specialist expertise would strengthen the programme.

2. Academic Quality Assurance

• Review selected lectures, seminars, tutorials, learning materials and other academic content from a subject-specialist perspective.

• Check content for academic accuracy, relevance, appropriate depth and level.

• Identify gaps, inaccuracies or areas requiring clarification or further development.

• Support the Academic Curriculum Manager and Head of Programme in maintaining a high and consistent academic standard across the Stream.

3. Essay & Assessment Framework

• Provide subject-specific input into the development of essay questions and prompts.

• Advise on the academic skills and competencies students should demonstrate, including critical thinking, analytical reasoning, evaluation of evidence, interpretation of data and application of theory to real-world contexts.

• Contribute to Stream-specific assessment criteria and feedback guidelines.

• Help establish a clear standard for strong pre-university academic work within the Stream.

4. Essay Assessment & Individualised Feedback

• Assess student essays according to the agreed Stream-specific criteria.

• Within 24 hours of the essay submission deadline (2pm on Wednesday of the second week for each programme), review all essays and nominate those that merit an Excellence Award. Expected workload will be communicated in advance.

• Provide detailed, constructive and individualised written
